premises.text: Last-minute personal-service booking by dialing many merchants is inefficient while idle local capacity goes unused
premises.evidence_span: painful process of dialing all of those merchants just to find one that was willing to take my money

premises.text: Customers can place a personal-service request on web or mobile and name their own price and terms
premises.evidence_span: place a request for personal service, and you can even name your own price

premises.text: Accepted bids charge the customer's card and schedule the service on both calendars
premises.evidence_span: When this merchant hits accept, my credit card is immediately charged and the service is scheduled on both of our calendars

premises.text: Merchants get customer acquisition with no upfront cost, prepaid bottom-of-funnel demand, timing certainty, and accept only when they have excess capacity
premises.evidence_span: A merchant working with BidZ faces no upfront investment at all

premises.text: The platform flips listings so the customer offers themselves and BidZ solicits many local merchants at once
premises.evidence_span: flips the equation and allows a customer to offer themselves to a business

premises.text: Services are fulfilled only by verified, rated local businesses rather than peer consumers
premises.evidence_span: BidZ is only connecting you with a verified, rated local business

value.text: Customers get personal services on their terms while merchants monetize idle capacity
value.evidence_span: A customer gets an appointment on their terms, and a business gets a paying customer through the door

causal_links.evidence_span: When you submit a bid on BidZ, we are effectively knocking on 200 doors for you
we give customers the deals and the services that they want on their terms
we allow merchants to bring more money through their door
prefer to get our hair cut by a professional instead of getting it cut by our neighbor

notes: Haircut/nail/dog-walking service list folded as one personal-services marketplace surface. Merchant channel pains (expensive/complicated/risky/no control) folded into P4 as one acquisition-terms package. Singletons D2 and D3 retained as independently revisable merchant-economics and trust modules.
